family_reports.body: This system allows legal kidnapping, because there are no checks and balances for Juvenile Court Judges. Judge Kristen Johnson has caused tremendous trauma to not only me and my son but our entire family. Director Randall Galbraith and Supervisor Karmen Lauth intentionally delayed the process of developing a caseplan for me to obtain custody. Then lied under oath about my contact with the agency
I want to see them all burn in hell. If I ever get the chance to fully tell my story, this is when I'll give the most impactful statement.

The system has DESTROYED my whole family we had a living family full of MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS and a retired Police Chief- none of us are able to get kinship!!! Children have been traumatized by the state and NEVER WERE. THEY WERE HAPPY, HEALTHY, & THRIVING.

Complete destroyed us my daughters are in my life we are trying to get their brother home his GAL is who has him lied said he was adopted as well to his sister's they asked her about the childsupport an she freaked out stopped all contact he will be 12 this year jayden joe alexander lopez ERIKA CERVI HAS MY SON

This systemic issue in Hancock county unjustly kept the children from all relatives to break bonds. They ignored phone calls and requests. They ignore ombudsman recommendations. They denied kinship with no written denials. We have missed every milestone and holidays over the past almost 2 years. It has caused many family issues. During this time Kelli tried to stop us from being licensed fosters and said we will not get these children to our first home study worker. We became licensed in July 2025. We have had several children placed with us but still requests for kinship of the children have been ignored. She cut and paste a court document and said this is why and sent it in an email. We have never been in court. We currently have a foster child that we have had placed in our home county for almost 10 months. Please make it make sense. It’s about abuse of power, retaliation, abuse of funding and just pure evil. The children have been traumatized more being in foster care than had then been placed other loving family. They never did a Kinnect case.

No accountability to this day.
